description: Time-resolved co-visibility regression: exploits within-pair J variation (distance fixed, J varies) to separate common-view from distance structure

broadcast_global.label: broadcast_global
broadcast_global.distance_fit_separated_controls: alpha residualised on [Jbar, cos(Delta-lon)] before binning; the null applies the identical residualisation, so the kappa_null*Jbar(d) leakage that heavy-tailed the uncontrolled null R^2 distribution is removed by construction
broadcast_global.stage1: pooled common-view slope kappa with pair fixed effects (alpha = mean_e[p - kappa*J]); per-pair beta was replaced: its noise entered alpha multiplied by Jbar and attenuated the stage-2 partial correlation toward zero through the d-Jbar collinearity (errors-in-variables).
broadcast_global.covisibility: per-epoch Jaccard of visible-satellite sets computed from the day's real SP3 ephemerides at UTC seconds-of-day (GPS-only; the nominal 24-satellite model is arbitrarily Earth-phased and scrambles the per-epoch J, attenuating kappa ~4x).
broadcast_global.T4_temporal_rule: distance_fit_significant = (separated R^2 > 0.2 AND separated R^2 sigma > 3.0 vs the identically residualised epoch-shuffle null AND 500 < separated lambda < 20000); common_view_separated = (|partial corr(alpha, log d | Jbar)| > 0.10 AND PC sigma > 3.0); T4_temporal_pass requires BOTH. The scored distance fit is on alpha residualised on [Jbar, cos(Delta-lon)] -- the raw binned fit is descriptive only, since it attributes neither the Jbar-aligned nor the longitude-phased components. frozen_S2 = (|PC| > 0.15 AND OOS R^2 gain > 0.02).

synthetic_common_view_only_null.description: Synthetic receiver clocks generated solely from shared SP3 visible-satellite clock noise plus local receiver noise (matched to broadcast short-baseline SNR, zero TEP field) passed through the identical two-stage pooled-kappa estimator.
